chunks: Fie on you and those you worship besides God! Will you not understand?

key_terms.أُفٍّ: An expression of reproach or disdain

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Fie on you' signify in the context of idol worship in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Anbiya is often cited to emphasize the primacy of 'Aql (intellect) as a divine faculty for recognizing Tawhid, contrasting the blind imitation of ancestors with rational conviction. The reproach 'Ufan lakum' underscores the disappointment of the Divine in those who possess the capacity for reason yet choose idolatry, a theme central to the Shia understanding of prophetic mission as an appeal to human intellect.
